description.value: A comparison of clinical, neuropsychological, neuropsychiatric, and voxel-based morphometry findings in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia associated with corticobasal degeneration versus Pick’s disease, with healthy older controls.

spans.text: In this study, we examined these autopsy-proven patient groups using neuropsychological, neuropsychiatric, and quantitative anatomic methods to delineate distinct clinical profiles that might aid in the prediction of underlying CBD.

description.value: An observational comparison of autopsy-proven patient groups and healthy older controls.

value: VBM of gray matter atrophy showed significant bilateral loss in the ventral anterior insulas, caudates, middle frontal gyrii, postcentral gyrii, inferior occipital gyrii, and cerebellum, with additional predominantly right-sided frontal and temporal atrophy and predominantly left-sided inferior frontal, supramarginal, and postcentral atrophy.
These findings indicate extensive frontal, insular, striatal, temporal, parietal, occipital, and cerebellar atrophy in bvFTD(Pick's) relative to healthy older controls.

spans.text: VBM of gray matter atrophy showed significant loss bilaterally in the ventral anterior insulas, caudates, middle frontal gyrii, postcentral gyrii, inferior occipital gyrii, and cerebellum (p<0.05 FWE) (Figures 1 & 3, Table 2). Atrophy was more prominent on the right in the gyrus rectus, the pars triangularis of the inferior frontal gyrus, the superior frontal gyrus, and the inferior and middle temporal gyrii. Predominantly left-sided atrophy was seen in the pars opercularis of the inferior frontal gyrus, and in the supramarginal gyrus.

model_settings.value: SPM5 voxel-based morphometry with spatial normalization, segmentation, modulation, light cleanup of partitions, and 12 mm FWHM isotropic Gaussian smoothing; age and sex were included as confounding covariates and total intracranial volume as a global covariate. Group comparisons used FWE correction at p<0.05 for patient-versus-control analyses and uncorrected p<0.01 for direct patient-group comparisons.

spans.text: MRI images were pre-processed primarily using SPM5 default settings and tissue probability maps, though light cleanup of partitions was performed.

Regionally specific differences in grey matter volumes at each voxel were assessed using the general linear model, and the significance of each effect was determined using the theory of Gaussian fields.
